title: skills: point `skills/objectstack-platform` at the new marketplace handbook (`/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook`), the Skills-docs follow-up #27321 owes
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: a follow-up owed by landed work. PR #27321 (merged, `Fixes #27240`) added `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` and left its skills link out on purpose, because `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H) and the docs PR stays off it. Its body says so: "Follow-up line, deliberately not in this PR (governed surface): `skills/objectstack-platform` gains one link line to `/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook`." Child of #27293 (E3, author surface). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Work

One line in `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (or the reference file that covers publishing, if that is where an app-authoring agent reads about `os package publish`) pointing at `/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook`, paid for under the skills token ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`; check the file's headroom first). Today the skill names the `marketplace` service once (`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:356`, read at `origin/main` `65b49208`) and nothing about listing or publishing an app.

## Business reason

The agent that writes an app reads the skills first. Without this line it never finds the page that says what a listing is made of and what the customer's administrator will go through, which is North Star step ④.

## Reader

The `domain:skills` lane, or the epic PM inside #27293's subtree. Tier H: a seat drafts, the maintainer lands.

## Dedupe

`gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=all` recent 500, titles grepped for `marketplace-handbook|objectstack-platform`: 0 hits; control `marketplace` on the same set: 3 hits (#27293, #27284, #27240).
